title: A little heavy
text: A little heavy. This is a great scraper to pick up many things. The only problem I have is It's slightly a little heavier than I expected because The steel is very Good quality. I wish the edge was tapered just a little bit more as well

Durable & Versatile Kitchen Tool: This scraper kitchen tool from Abllore can do nearly everything a knife can. With this cake scraper, you can switch from scraping to cutting and vice versa, without hassle. Carefully crafted not to bend.

Griddle Scraper Chopper: Also perfect for BBQ and grill as well as for cast iron griddle or flat top cooking as griddle grill accessories for your home, kitchen or backyard barbecue. Ergonomic and comfortable non-slip rubber handle.

Easy to Clean: Heavy-duty baking tools - food scraper no rust, sturdy, and easy to clean in the dishwasher. Reusable, durable and non-sticky. No longer have to waste your time and effort if you have these efficient gadgets. Just to wash in warm or normal water.
